description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_ppm_periodic.esm (model AdvectionPPM, test mms_transport) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Pins the PPM lowering (ic wiring at t=0), the transport error bound at t=0.1, and EXACT conservation (mean(u) preserved to the bit). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.
